audit: R67-I identity, source-record and generic-inventory audit
scope: Read-only source/code audit plus isolated CPU builder probe. No image, webpage, panorama, or browser-render inspection performed. No product/source modifications made; report and probe artifacts written under /tmp.

authority.releaseLabelCaution: Current master/queue plan names I as R66-I and J as R67-J. This audit uses requested task name R67-I; do not silently relabel source plan history.

recommendations: Implement unknown-inventory removal only for exact I host IDs/items 14, 16, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29; assert exact pre-removal mesh/collider signatures, preserve rollback and no-current-empty-inventory claim.
Do not globally disable retainLegacyHall or retainLegacyRoom. J hosts 遂初堂、延趣楼、萃赏楼、符望阁、倦勤斋 share code and are outside I29.

Preserve Huangji aligned GLB/atomic fallback, Yangxing source-attested retained throne, Fori/Fanhua altar outlines, Jingqi stage and Leshou jade-mountain plinth as separately reviewed architectural/inventory classes.
Treat QingShou aggregate and second-hall as one unresolved physical binding candidate, not duplicate completed entities. Keep four-courtyard aggregate open and do not create duplicate geometry.
Repair south/north thirteen-row subgroup hierarchy: both children of FC-ABA67505AC, neither a child of the other. Maintain both subgroup rows and unresolved instance enumeration.
Bind 景祺阁戏台 to existing component-level stage only after exact identity/period review; lack of queue runtime binding does not mean model is absent.

Differentiate source absence from unreviewed available source and from engineering gaps. Furniture removal can proceed as removal of unsupported generic invention without claiming photo-accurate replacement or empty museum rooms.
Do not mark I29 complete from engineering cleanup: initial canonical snapshot has 55 UNREVIEWED facets and 3 NOT_APPLICABLE facets, all 29 currentCycleAccepted false.

identityFindings.finding: Both register/place bindings reference the same single five-bay hall. Group owns runtime candidate; second hall has no direct runtime binding. physicalIdentityVerified false and doNotMergeBeforeLocation true must not be lost.

South parentCandidates includes north, and north requiredChildIds includes south. Master parentText puts both under combined group; current substring-derived relationship must not be promoted to verified containment.
Stage source record lacks runtime binding but buildJingqi has 3 stage slabs and backdrop panels; preserve one component identity under Jingqi.

Multiple records use FC-E66DFE768F (the NingShou main hall) as candidate parent for NingShou district, or use spatial neighbors as parent (e.g. 阅是楼 → 庆寿堂, 梵华楼 → 佛日楼). These are unresolved text relations, not authoritative building containment.

findings: Scope-safe early return suppresses creation of generic pieces and their colliders; it does not post-delete arbitrary mesh/bounds and is therefore safe under Changyin rotation.
For every removed solid preset mesh, independent world-coordinate bounds matched exactly one baseline collider; current collider sequence exactly equals retained baseline boxes.
All 19 frozen-profile builds merge successfully; target delta is exactly 576 triangles (48 boxes), all non-target merged counts unchanged at reviewed inventory+rail commit.
Seven production ZoneBase builds retain UNKNOWN / knownEmpty false inventory metadata on architectural records and registered rooms.
All 49 mutated identity/zone/profile/envelope negative controls reject unauthorized near-match paths.

Existing test is strong on exact raw geometry, collision sequence and non-target J preservation; add permanent merged-output and negative-control assertions from this independent probe for durable regression coverage.
